description: Defines the URLRequestThrottlerEntry class, which manages request throttling logic including back-off algorithms and request rate limiting for URL requests within the Chromium project.

classes.name: URLRequestThrottlerEntry
classes.description: Manages request rate limiting and back-off logic for URL requests, including exponential back-off and sliding window request counting.

methods.name: URLRequestThrottlerEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the throttler entry with default or custom parameters.

methods.name: IsEntryOutdated
methods.description: Checks if the throttler entry is outdated and should be garbage collected.

methods.name: DisableBackoffThrottling
methods.description: Disables back-off throttling for this entry.

methods.name: DetachManager
methods.description: Detaches the manager pointer from this entry.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request should be rejected based on throttling rules.

methods.name: ReserveSendingTimeForNextRequest
methods.description: Reserves a time slot for the next request.

methods.name: GetExponentialBackoffReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the time when back-off period ends.

methods.name: UpdateWithResponse
methods.description: Updates throttling state based on response status code.

methods.name: ImplGetTimeNow
methods.description: Returns current time; virtual for testing.

methods.name: GetBackoffEntry
methods.description: Returns the backoff entry object; virtual for testing.

methods.name: set_sliding_window_release_time
methods.description: Sets the sliding window release time (test utility).
